- **Instagram only:** the same two identities hold on all 34 posts that have data. Post 35 has "–" for Video Views, so I skipped it.
- **Case Notes:** the weekday mapping in the Notes ("Mon HBO Max/Viacom") conflicts with the Description table, where Viacom is a Tuesday account. I flagged this in the report for cleanup.
- **Prod tab:** the login helper also opened a prod tab, which I never used.
